'''Choke-collars''' were illegal devices used by both criminals and [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] operatives around the time the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was formed. The device was fitted around one's neck, and would, when activated, constrict, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the wearer. They also included a function which would kill the wearer if the individual who affixed the collar was killed. [[Ysanne Isard]] was known to use them.
